🇲🇽🌎 PESO STRENGTHENS TO 17.28 PER DOLLAR — JUNE 2 CLOSE

The Mexican peso closed Monday at 17.28 per dollar, up 0.45% (7 centavos) versus Friday's close, per El Financiero. The peso gained as the DXY softened on signs of US-Iran negotiation progress and dovish noises from a former Bank of Japan board member.

For context: at the start of 2025 the peso traded above 20 per dollar. Eighteen months into Sheinbaum's sexenio, through Section 232 steel tariffs, T-MEC review pressure, and the Middle East war, the peso is one of the strongest emerging market currencies on earth.

The "Mexico is collapsing" narrative the rating agencies sell hasn't reached the FX desk.

Source: El Financiero / Infobae

🔥🇲🇽 4T ANTI-CORRUPTION OFFICE SANCTIONS 13 FEDERAL OFFICIALS

The Secretaría Anticorrupción just sanctioned 13 federal officials across Pemex, ISSSTE, Hospital General de México, Banjercito, AIFA, and the airports authority. Penalties include disqualifications, suspensions, and a public reprimand — for falsified handover documents, neglected patients, fuel spills, and workplace abuse.

"Sanctions were imposed according to law and proportionality criteria… this Secretaría will defend resolutions with the same firmness they were issued."

Under the old regime the same conduct got promotions. The 4T's instinct is now structural: even a missing handover form costs you the job.

Source: Regeneración

🇲🇽🏭 IMSS BIENESTAR PUTS 13 BILLION PESOS INTO PUBLIC HEALTH TECH IN 2026

IMSS Bienestar is deploying 32,000+ medical devices across hospitals and 8,400 health centers this year: 8 linear accelerators, 11 MRIs, 70 AI-powered mammograms (plus 100+ standard ones), AI tomographs, brachytherapy, and robotic surgery systems. 68 surgeons just got robotic-surgery certified.

"We are convinced that health system technology must serve to bring justice," said director Alejandro Svarch Pérez.

For four decades the neoliberal model meant a Mexican kid in Nayarit had to travel hours for a CT scan. Now the Hospital Mixto in Jesús María — population 47,000 — gets one with AI built in.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🇵🇸 128 LEBANESE HEALTH WORKERS KILLED BY ISRAELI STRIKES IN 3 MONTHS — WHO

Between March 3 and June 2, Israeli attacks killed 128 healthcare workers in Lebanon and wounded 332 more across nearly 190 strikes on the health sector, the World Health Organization confirmed today. Two hospitals were damaged. Six can no longer provide maternity care. Patients in southern Lebanon now wait up to 48 hours to reach a referral hospital.

"These attacks kill and mutilate, and deprive the population of needed health services," said Dr. Abdinasir Abubakar, WHO representative in Lebanon.

The US-mediated April 17 ceasefire never stopped the bombs. Over 3,400 Lebanese civilians killed since March. The hospitals were always the target.

Source: Contralínea / OMS

🔥🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM ON THE PAN'S "NEW CADRES" FOX AND CALDERÓN: HYPOCRISY AND SHAMELESSNESS

After Fox and Calderón reappeared together this weekend to prop up Chihuahua governor Maru Campos, Sheinbaum opened her mañanera with one question: "Where are the young people from the PAN or PRI? Where are the new cadres?"

Her answer: "the doctrine of conservatism, of the right, is hypocrisy" and there is "much shamelessness in saying things without seeing what they did." She rolled the tape of Fox attacking 4T social programs — the same Fox whose presidential residence bought 400-dollar towels.

The opposition's "renewal" is two ex-presidents whose sexenios she has already called narcogobiernos. The bench is empty.

Source: La Jornada

🚨🇲🇽 RUBIO MANUFACTURES NEW PRETEXT: MEXICAN CARTEL DRONES "THREATEN US INTERESTS"

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told a Senate hearing this week that Mexican cartels "are using drones" and "we should imagine that at some point they could even use them against us, against our interests."

In his written testimony, Rubio added: "for too long we have allowed hostile regimes, cartels, criminal gangs and foreign adversaries to act without control in our own territory."

Translation: Washington is laying the rhetorical groundwork for cross-border strikes Sheinbaum has already rejected as a violation of Mexican sovereignty. Yesterday she told Ambassador Johnson to "respect Mexico's internal affairs." The "drone threat" is the next slide in the deck.

Source: La Jornada

🇲🇽🏭 <u>SHCP UNDERSPENDS 351 BILLION PESOS — BUT HEALTH +25.9%, SOCIAL SPENDING +10.9%</u>

Federal spending Jan–Apr 2026 came in 351 billion pesos BELOW the programmed amount per El Financiero: 3.175 trillion executed vs 3.526T budgeted. Physical investment fell 18.4% real. But social development spending rose 10.9% real — well above the past decade's 2.7% average — driven by health +25.9%, education +8.3%, and social protection +8.3%. The Q1 spending gap produced a 178B-peso fiscal deficit, LOWER than last year's 181B. Public debt holds at 50% of GDP.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICAN WOMAN TO RUN VATICAN COMMUNICATIONS — FIRST LAY WOMAN EVER TO LEAD A DICASTERY</u>

Pope Leo XIV just named Mexico City–born María Montserrat Alvarado as Prefect of the Dicastery for Communication, effective November 1, 2026 — the FIRST lay woman in history to lead a dicastery at the Holy See. She'll run Vatican News, Radio Vaticana, L'Osservatore Romano, the Press Office, and the entire Vatican digital infrastructure. A Mexicana now sets the media line for 1.4 billion Catholics worldwide.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>100,000+ AT MONUMENTO A LA REVOLUCIÓN: "IF THEY WANT TO SEE THE TIGER AWAKE, LET THEM INVADE"</u>

Over 100,000 packed the Monumento a la Revolución to back Sheinbaum against the US-backed interference campaign. Víctor Hernández, one of the attendees: "the president is not alone — all Mexicans are the tiger, and if they want to see it awake, let them invade our homeland" — a direct echo of AMLO's 2018 line. Some carried banners crediting Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro for their families. The chant didn't stop: ¡Presidenta, no está sola!

🚨🇲🇽 <u>STAY IN YOUR LANE — SHEINBAUM TO US AMBASSADOR JOHNSON</u>

After US Ambassador Ronald Johnson posted on X that "la lucha contra los cárteles debe unirnos, no dividirnos," Sheinbaum's answer landed flat: "es importante que el embajador se quede en el tema bilateral y que respete los asuntos internos." Mexico's security is for Mexicans. Self-determination and non-intervention are written into the Constitution.
